parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of records to return for the query.
Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that marks the position from which to start the query. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the beginning.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

> For information about how to obtain the abbreviation of an Alibaba Cloud service name, see the \`ProductCode\` parameter in [ListProducts](~~440555~~).
